fields.summary_ko.0: CoreWeave (CRWV) reported Q3 revenue growth of 168% to $3.66B, sending shares up 25%, though Jefferies analyst noted that Amazon (AMZN) offers comparable AI demand at lower risk.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amazon Web Services delivered Q3 revenue growth of 39% to $46.0B, with AWS single-quarter revenue contribution ($13.0B) more than five times CoreWeave's entire quarter increment ($2.3B).
fields.summary_ko.2: According to bernardstein, hyperscalers represent 42% of the 199GW data center pipeline while neo-cloud represents only 4%, and CoreWeave's interest expense amounts to 23% of quarterly revenue.
